Implementation detail for this story (the description carries the decisions). Cites on origin/main 083620b0.

Hooks, each a named module-level function in `_mcp_derive.py`:
- PRE: `readonly_gate(label)` raises the exact current message `"<label> is disabled: this server is read-only (REBAR_MCP_READONLY)"`; `jira_sync_gate(label)`; `fsck_recover_gate`.
- PINS: `include_inbound=True` (show_ticket), `return_alias=True` (create_ticket, create_idea, create_identity), `_creation_channel="mcp"` (create_ticket, create_idea, create_identity, log_session), `report_only=ctx.readonly` (fsck; evaluated per call).
- POST: `with_push` (`_with_push`), `ack` (`_ack`, drops None keys), `escalation_ack` (link_tickets), `description_warning_ack` (edit_ticket), `cross_session(id_param)` (`_cross_session`, key set only when non-None), `plan_review_health` (`rebar.audit.read.plan_review_health`, show_ticket), `discovery_rows(full)` (`_discovery_rows`, `_mcp_reads.py:264-285`; list_tickets and ready_tickets), `bound_list(tool)` (`_mcp_budget._bound_list_payload`; list_tickets, ready_tickets, search), `id_alias_only` (log_session).

The eight input overrides the table must carry (library annotation after the annotation story vs the MCP contract to preserve):
| tool.param | library | MCP (pinned) |
|---|---|---|
| `list_tickets.full` | default `True` | default `False` (lean-by-default, story 98b8-5f08-1569-45cc, payload budget) |
| `list_tickets.priority` | `int | str | None` (`_reads.py:148`; str is a CLI cast) | `int | None` |
| `bridge_run.profile` | `str | None = None`, falls back to env `MODE` (`_bridge_runner.py:77`) | `str = "dry-run"` (safety default) |
| `set_file_impact.impact` | `list[FileImpactEntry] | str` | `list[FileImpactEntry]` |
| `set_verify_commands.commands` | `list[VerifyCommandEntry] | str` | `list[VerifyCommandEntry]` |
| `sign_manifest.manifest` | `list[str] | str` | `list[str]` |
| `attach_commits.commits` | `list[str | dict[str, Any]]` | `list[str]` |
| `summary.ticket_ids` | `*ticket_ids: str` | `ticket_ids: list[str]`, calling `rebar.summary(*ticket_ids)` |
| `transition_ticket` order | `force, reason, close_class` | `close_class, reason, force` (positional callers in `tests/unit/test_cross_session_mcp.py:278`) |
Every other parameter matches by name, type and default (KEYWORD_ONLY vs POSITIONAL has no schema effect). 0 of 48 MCP descriptions equal the library docstring (238 description lines, 14,865 chars), so every description is a verbatim `ToolSpec.description` string, not the docstring.

The ten declared divergences (carried verbatim from `tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json` into each spec's `divergence` field): `comment_ticket` <- `comment` strips `allow_secret_pattern` (audited force override for the write-time secret screen, bug e7a9; MCP callers must not suppress the guard) and `source` (import provenance); `create_idea` <- `idea` pins `return_alias=True`, `_creation_channel="mcp"`; `create_identity` <- `create_identity` pins the same two and does not expose `tags` (applied afterwards with `tag_ticket`); `create_ticket` <- `create_ticket` pins the same two and strips `source`; `edit_ticket` <- `edit_ticket` enumerates the eleven editable fields because `**fields` cannot be a JSON schema (a new editable library field must be added to the spec); `fsck` <- `fsck` derives `report_only` from the server's read-only gate rather than the caller; `log_session` <- `append_session_log` pins `_creation_channel="mcp"`; `ready_tickets` <- `ready` adds the MCP-only `full` through `_discovery_rows` (story 98b8); `search` <- `search` fixes `full=False` (bug 494b-2dd3-e9d3-4fb0 payload budget); `show_ticket` <- `show_ticket` pins `include_inbound=True`.

Golden capture command (run from the schema story's landed tree before writing derivation code; record the SHA in the test docstring):
```
REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_LLM=1 python -c 'import asyncio, json; from rebar.mcp_server import build_server; t = asyncio.run(build_server().list_tools()); print(json.dumps({x.name: {"inputSchema": x.inputSchema, "description": x.description, "annotations": x.annotations.model_dump() if x.annotations else None} for x in t}, indent=1, sort_keys=True))' > tests/interfaces/facades/mcp_tool_surface_golden.json
```

Baseline maintenance: this story deletes `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py`, a censused `ci_gate` mechanism, and its `make lint` invocation. Because `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py:357-364` asserts the committed baseline equals the live tree, run `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` in the same change and commit `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` (operator-sanctioned on the epic; precedent commit 81da792). comments.body:
ADR 0118 text (`docs/adr/0118-mcp-surface-derived-from-library.md`, modelled on the existing ADR form):

Title: The MCP tool surface is derived from the library facade (MCP only). Status: Accepted. Ticket: this story. Supersedes: the "no generated adapters (Pattern A)" clause of topaz-blubbery-mice (c996-8a5f-5123-4f8e), for the MCP surface only. Relates to: ADR 0100 (untouched).

Context. topaz-blubbery-mice (2026-08) built the behavioural write-parity oracle and decided not to generate the lib/CLI/MCP adapters because behaviour is single-sourced and the adapters carry irreducible hand-written value (LLM-facing docstrings, CLI ergonomics). The oracle asserts behaviour on three write ops; it cannot see shape. On 2026-09-02 lowly-lawrencium-ovenbird (3a02-66ea-9229-470c) found 41 canonical properties missing from the MCP output mirror and model defaults emitting schema-violating nulls, while the name-only parity gate (`check_mcp_library_parity.py`) had passed throughout. The MCP tools are 48 closures that call one `rebar.*` function each; three undeclared input divergences exist today (`list_tickets.priority`, `bridge_run.profile`, `transition_ticket` parameter order).

Decision. For MCP only: (1) `outputSchema`s are the canonical `src/rebar/schemas/*.json` files, inlined and advertised directly; tools return the library payload unchanged, absent keys stay absent, and the pydantic mirror is deleted. (2) The 48 library-backed tools are derived at registration from the annotated library signatures through one factory (`_mcp_derive.derive_tool`) plus an explicit override table (`_mcp_tool_specs.py`) that carries every deliberate divergence, every pinned kwarg, every per-op hook and the LLM-facing description verbatim. The 16 MCP-only tools stay hand-written. The CLI stays under ADR 0100; Pattern A remains rejected there because CLI ergonomics are not a projection of the library signature.

Consequences. One contract per shape; a schema edit changes the wire without a second edit. Divergence is declared in the override table or it does not exist; the name-only parity gate, its manifest and the model drift gate are deleted. Explicit nulls the mirror invented disappear (pre-1.0 BREAKING, recorded in release notes). LLM-facing text is pinned byte-for-byte by a golden of the live tool surface. The hand-written value the original clause protected is preserved in the table, not in code copies.

Release note for this story: none beyond the ADR reference; input schemas, descriptions and annotations are pinned byte-identical to the schema-story server by the golden file.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The 48 `exact`/`co_names` MCP tools are hand-copied closures (`src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py`, `_mcp_writes.py`) whose only guard is a 572-LOC introspection script (`scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py`), a 486-LOC test and a 919-line manifest that compare names. The epic's experiment found three undeclared shape divergences it cannot see (`list_tickets.priority`, `bridge_run.profile`, `transition_ticket` parameter order). Ticket topaz-blubbery-mice (c996-8a5f-5123-4f8e) chose "no generated adapters (Pattern A)" for all three surfaces; the post-oracle escape lowly-lawrencium-ovenbird shows the MCP copy still drifts. ADR 0118 supersedes that clause for MCP only; the CLI stays under ADR 0100. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
New `src/rebar/_mcp_derive.py` (factory plus hooks, about 250 LOC) and `src/rebar/_mcp_tool_specs.py` (the override table, about 500 LOC). `ToolSpec` is a frozen dataclass: `name, library, registrar ("read"|"write"|"bridge_mutation"), annotation (preset key), description (verbatim, including the current 8-space continuation indentation so bytes are identical), strip (extra params), params (per-param annotation and default overrides), order, pins (fixed kwargs; callables evaluated per call), pre (gate hooks), post (result hooks), schema (kind plus name, reused by `_mcp_schema`)`. The factory `derive_tool(mcp, spec, ctx)` resolves hints with `typing.get_type_hints(fn, globalns=vars(sys.modules[fn.__module__]), localns=vars(rebar.types))` (never `inspect.signature(eval_str=True)`, which raises on the `TYPE_CHECKING`-only TypedDict names); builds an `inspect.Signature` from the library parameters minus `repo_root`, `_`-prefixed names and `spec.strip`, applying `params`/`order` (VAR_POSITIONAL becomes `list[T]`); creates ONE wrapper `def tool(*args, **kwargs)` that `sig.bind`s, runs the PRE hooks, calls `getattr(rebar, spec.library)(**bound, **pins)`, runs the POST hooks in order, and sets `__name__`, `__doc__`, `__signature__`, `__annotations__`; then registers with `mcp.tool(annotations=presets[spec.annotation])(tool)`. Because `mcp.tool` is the already-layered decorator, the four existing layers attach unchanged: error guard (`_mcp_errors.py:88-138`), JS-safe guard (`:223-259`), advisory suppression (`_lib_warn.py:67-107`), operation snapshot (`_operation_config.py:313-357`), composed in `mcp_server.py:606-632`; `functools.wraps` propagates `__signature__` through them. The named hooks, pins, the eight input overrides, and the ten declared divergences carried verbatim from the manifest are itemised in this ticket's first comment. Registration-time gating is unchanged: `register_write_tools` still returns early when `ctx.readonly()` (`_mcp_writes.py:172`) and `register_bridge_tools` registers the four bridge mutations only when not read-only (`_mcp_reads.py:164`); the 16 `mcp_only` tools remain hand-written in their registrars, so `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py` grouping and output are unchanged; `_mcp_inflight` and `_cap_workflow_payload` are consumed only by `mcp_only` tools (`_mcp_llm.py:23`, `get_workflow_*`) and stay where they are. Delete the parity script, its test, the manifest, `Makefile:298-310`, the stub at `tests/unit/test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py:324-326`, and the manifest row at `docs/generated-artifacts.md:39` (adding the golden's row). Write `docs/adr/0118-mcp-surface-derived-from-library.md` (text in the second comment) with `docs/adr/.numbers/0118`, index it in `docs/adr/README.md`, and describe the derivation and override table in `docs/architecture.md`'s MCP section.

## Scope
New: `src/rebar/_mcp_derive.py`, `src/rebar/_mcp_tool_specs.py`, `tests/interfaces/facades/mcp_tool_surface_golden.json`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_tool_surface_golden.py`, `docs/adr/0118-mcp-surface-derived-from-library.md`, `docs/adr/.numbers/0118`. Delete: `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py`, `tests/unit/test_mcp_library_parity.py`, `tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json`. Edit: `src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py`, `src/rebar/_mcp_writes.py`, `src/rebar/_mcp_schema.py` (its table reads `spec.schema`), `Makefile`, `tests/unit/test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py`, `docs/generated-artifacts.md`, `docs/adr/README.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`. Kept unchanged: `tests/interfaces/facades/test_parity.py`, `tests/interfaces/test_write_parity_oracle.py`, `write_parity_contract.py`, `adapters.py`, `.github/complexity-baseline.json` (`register_read_tools`/`register_write_tools` lose nested defs and bucket `stale`, which passes). Out of scope: the 16 MCP-only tools, the CLI, the library signatures.

## Testing
Golden capture, run once from the schema story's landed tree before writing any derivation code, with the SHA recorded in the test docstring (command in the first comment) producing `tests/interfaces/facades/mcp_tool_surface_golden.json` with `inputSchema`, `description`, and `annotations` for all 64 tools. `test_mcp_tool_surface_golden.py`: `test_live_surface_equals_golden` parametrized over the 64 golden names (dict comparison; `required` lists compared as lists); `test_golden_covers_exactly_the_live_tools` (set equality both ways); `test_every_derived_tool_names_a_public_library_symbol` (each spec's `library` is in `rebar.__all__`); `test_stripped_params_are_only_repo_root_private_or_declared` (a spec may strip only `repo_root`, `_*`, or a name listed in its `divergence` note). Behavioural suites pass unchanged: `tests/interfaces/facades/test_parity.py`, `tests/interfaces/test_write_parity_oracle.py`, `tests/unit/test_cross_session_mcp.py`, `test_mcp_writes.py`, `test_mcp_output_schema_coverage.py`, `test_mcp_output_schema_canonical.py`. `python scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py --check`, `python scripts/check_adr_numbers.py`, `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] For all 64 tools, `list_tools()` `inputSchema`, `description`, and `annotations` equal the committed golden (the golden test).
- [ ] `_mcp_reads.py` and `_mcp_writes.py` contain `def` bodies only for the 16 `mcp_only` tools plus registrars and helpers; `grep -c "@mcp.tool" src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py src/rebar/_mcp_writes.py` reports 8 and 1.
- [ ] `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py`, `tests/unit/test_mcp_library_parity.py`, and the manifest are gone and `make lint` no longer invokes the script (grep and `make -n lint`).
- [ ] The behavioural parity suites named above pass without modification (`git diff --stat` on those paths is empty).
- [ ] `docs/mcp-reference.md` is unchanged (`--check`); ADR 0118 passes `check_adr_numbers.py` and is indexed (CI).
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0; the complexity ratchet reports only `stale`; the mechanism ratchet reports `new=0` after `--update-stale` for the removed `scripts/check_*.py` gate.
